title: Adorable 2 bedroom with Full private bath!
description:
Enjoy our peaceful and centrally located Guest Suite w/private entrance!

Just 5 minutes from Opryland Mall,  The famous Opryland hotel/convention center, and only 15 minutes from Downtown! You will enjoy the perfect stay whether here for a bachelorette party, family vacation , work or even a weekend getaway! Our 2 bedroom, has a jack and Jill bathroom, Queen size bed in one bedroom and a sofa sleeper with queen bed in room 2, fully equipped with coffee maker, mini fridge, working station, tv’s!

The space
Room 1-Queen size bed, kuerig w/ coffee station, extra sheets, iron, iron board, Tv 

Room 2- Sleeper sofa w/ queen size pull out bed (equipped with secure bed covers) , mini fridge, work station, high top dining area with three stools,toaster oven, microwave, couch, TV, 

Bathroom-Double sinks, full bath tub and shower , toilet , towels and extra provided, shampoo, hair dryer,

Guest access
All guest have private access to both bedrooms and bathrooms away from myself and all other guest during their stay. All guest have a private entrance and access to enter and depart unit with their own code.

During your stay
Both Myself and co-host Mikel are available at anytime throughout guest stay for help or questions via. Air BNB app or by cell phone.

Other things to note
Guest have an outside sitting area with patio furniture and chairs to lounge in front of Guess suite and Grill access!
